item.title: 5th suspect charged, 6th person arrested in Tippecanoe County judge’s shooting
item.description: Five people have been arrested and charged in the shooting of a Tippecanoe County judge and his wife in mid-January at their Lafayette, Indiana, home, and a sixth person was arrested Wednesday.

item.title: Statement from FBI Cincinnati regarding the Hailey Buzbee investigation
item.description: FBI Cincinnati and other partner agencies are investigating the disappearance and death of Hailey Buzbee, and are committed to pursuing justice for her family.

item.title: Washington Square Mall study raises transparency concerns with tenants
item.description: City leaders, tenants, and the mall's owner discussed the future of Washington Square Mall at a meeting, expressing concerns about communication and transparency in the pre-development planning process.

item.title: Pizza Hut is closing hundreds of ‘underperforming’ locations
item.description: Yum! Brands is closing 250 underperforming Pizza Hut locations in the US, while Taco Bell and KFC continue to see positive sales growth.

item.title: Indianapolis man found guilty of armed drug trafficking and firearm charges
item.description: Deontai Williams, a convicted felon, was found guilty of trafficking in fentanyl, methamphetamine, and cocaine, as well as illegally possessing eight firearms while being a convicted felon.

item.title: Driver turns himself in after fatal hit-and-run in Indianapolis
item.description: Jevontae Wilkins turned himself in after striking a pedestrian with his car and killing him, and was arrested on the preliminary charge of leaving the scene of a vehicle crash resulting in death.

item.title: Plainfield schools issue notice ahead of student-organized walkout
item.description: The superintendent of the Plainfield Community School Corporation has warned that students who participate in a planned walkout protest on Friday will face disciplinary action, including being marked truant and potentially suspended.

item.title: Major drug bust operation in Indiana results in over 65 arrests
item.description: More than 65 people have been arrested following a 15-month investigation into illicit narcotics, firearms, and U.S. currency, resulting in the seizure of over $15,000 in U.S. currency and more than 3,575 grams of methamphetamine.
